posts.author: GreyStone84
posts.body: Hi, I'm looking mainly for broken fences. But if you have links to dilapidated objects, interior or exterior, that would be helpful as well. I'm currently looking through pages of links from these forums, but there are a lot and I haven't found much yet. Tilesets with spider webs, broken objects, broken boards, layered holes/cracks... all that kind of stuff. It would be very helpful. Thanks in advance!!

posts.author: EntangledPear
posts.body:
Candacis has some spider-webbed items in the attic tileset
here
.
Also try to search for PandaMaru's resources - she had a website, but I think it's down, but they should still be somewhere (I seem to remember getting some of her stuff from a German RPG Maker forum).
Caitlin Nicnubill also has some stuff you might use
here
.
Gmork has some fun spiderwebs
here
.
Here
are some spider-webbed and falling-apart things, too, in the dungeon section (use the download option, since the pictures are "photobucket-ed")
I didn't find broken fences (like in an autotile), only in a DLC that came with my copy of VX Ace, and it was a stone fence (you don't mention if your setting is medieval/fantasy or modern).

Wow, thanks for the help! There's some here I haven't come across yet and they look great. As for the fence, I had to make my own by cutting and pasting the VXAce resources. I wasn't really going for a certain style, I guess modern would be  the best option in this instance, but I was looking for a wooden fence. I was picturing in my head a picket fence style with the wood boards and having them fallen over or broken and just a run down kind of vibe.
